ExtraDock 5.0.6 - Faster, Lighter, and Better Behaved! ⚡🪶

⚡ Improvements

  • Dock keyboard shortcuts: Dock keyboard shortcuts now work more reliably!
  • Resource usage: ExtraDock now uses fewer system resources, especially CPU!
  • Reserve Dock Space: Reserved dock space now recovers more reliably after sleep and external monitor disconnections!

🐞 Bug Fixes

  • Rays effect: The Rays effect has been reworked with very lightweight rendering!
  • Ambient effects: Rays, Snow, and Fireworks now render behind app icons instead of covering them!
  • Top-pinned docks: Docks pinned to the top now sit correctly below the menu bar instead of overlapping it!
  • Desktop Widget labels: Labels now appear above desktop widgets while remaining underneath application windows, just like the dock widget!

What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraDock more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraDock community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
